# Magic Session Manager for Strapi 5

> Magic Session Manager (npm: strapi-plugin-magic-sessionmanager, plugin id: magic-sessionmanager) is a free, MIT-licensed Strapi 5 plugin that records every Users & Permissions sign-in as a session. Admins see who is online, end single sessions or all sessions of a user, and block accounts; the app gets logout routes, a "my devices" list, failed-login lockout and optional country rules.

Current version: __PACKAGE_VERSION__ (npm). The plugin sends no telemetry and needs no account or license key.

What it does:

- Sessions dashboard with Active, Idle and Ended counts, search, filters, CSV and JSON export and a details dialog per session (device, browser, IP address, location, security score).
- End one session, end all sessions of a user, delete a record or block a user. Ended sessions are rejected on the next request with 401.
- Content API under `/api/magic-sessionmanager` (Users & Permissions JWT, own sessions only, rate limited): `GET /my-sessions`, `GET /current-session`, `GET /user/:userId/sessions`, `POST /logout`, `POST /logout-all`, `POST /logout-others`, `DELETE /my-sessions/:sessionId`. `POST /api/auth/logout` also ends the current session.
- Login protection: temporary IP lockout after failed sign-ins, Content API rate limits, optional rejection of VPN, proxy or low-score sign-ins, country allow or block lists.
- IP location from a local MaxMind GeoLite2 database, from ipapi.co, or off.
- Security emails through Strapi's Email plugin and sign-in notifications to Discord or Slack.
- A Sessions panel next to each user in the Content Manager and an Online users widget on the Strapi homepage.
- Admin panel sessions: who is signed in to the Strapi admin panel; sign an admin out of one browser or everywhere.
- Works with `jwtManagement: 'refresh'` (Strapi's native sessions) and `'legacy-support'`, and with pm2 workers or Railway replicas on one PostgreSQL or MySQL database, without sticky sessions or Redis.
- Stored tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and never returned; retention deletes old history.

Requirements:

- Strapi `^5.50.0` and `@strapi/plugin-users-permissions` `^5.50.0` (tested on 5.50.0 and 5.63.0)
- Node.js `^22.22.2 || >=24.15.0`
- PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQLite (several processes need PostgreSQL or MySQL)
- `SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, required when `NODE_ENV=production`

Install:

```bash
npm install strapi-plugin-magic-sessionmanager
```

```typescript
// config/plugins.ts
export default () => ({
  'magic-sessionmanager': { enabled: true },
});
```

Then set `SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, run `npm run build` and `npm run develop`, and open Session Manager in the admin menu.

Configuration essentials:

- Admin permissions: `plugin::magic-sessionmanager.access`, `plugin::magic-sessionmanager.admin-sessions.read`, `plugin::magic-sessionmanager.admin-sessions.revoke`.
- Optional route policy `plugin::magic-sessionmanager.session-required` for an explicit per-route check; revocation works on every Content API route without it.
- Behind a proxy, turn on Koa's proxy mode or Trust proxy headers, otherwise all users share the proxy's IP address for the lockout.
